title: Walk in obedience
text: If you love me, keep my commandments. Choose one act of obedience today and do it before this walk ends. Love proves itself. (John 14:15)

title: Faith with feet
text: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Who will you forgive, serve, or encourage before this walk ends? Decide now. (James 1:22)

title: Count the cost
text: So therefore, any one of you who does not renounce all that he has cannot be my disciple. (Luke 14:33)
kjv: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple. (Luke 14:33, KJV)
web: So therefore whoever of you who doesn't renounce all that he has, he can't be my disciple. (Luke 14:33, WEB)
asv: So therefore whosoever he be of you that renounceth not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple. (Luke 14:33, ASV)

title: No excuses
text: The sluggard says there is a lion outside. Stop negotiating with obedience. The step you avoid is the step that sets you free. Take it. (Proverbs 22:13)

title: Examine yourselves
text: Examine yourselves, to see whether you are in the faith. Test yourselves. (2 Corinthians 13:5)
kjv: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. (2 Corinthians 13:5, KJV)
web: Test your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. (2 Corinthians 13:5, WEB)
asv: Try your own selves, whether ye are in the faith; prove your own selves. Or know ye not as to your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you? unless indeed ye be reprobate. (2 Corinthians 13:5, ASV)

title: First things first
text: Seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you. Check your ordering: what is first right now? (Matthew 6:33)

title: Do not be deceived
text: Do not be deceived: God is not mocked, for whatever one sows, that will he also reap. (Galatians 6:7)
kjv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap. (Galatians 6:7, KJV)
web: Don't be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap. (Galatians 6:7, WEB)
asv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap. (Galatians 6:7, ASV)

title: Speak the truth
text: Let your yes be yes and your no be no. One honest conversation is worth a hundred comfortable silences. Whom do you need to speak truth to in love? (Matthew 5:37)

title: Take up your cross
text: If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me. (Luke 9:23)
kjv: If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me. (Luke 9:23, KJV)
web: If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me. (Luke 9:23, WEB)
asv: And he said unto all, If any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me. (Luke 9:23, ASV)

title: Today, not tomorrow
text: Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts. Delayed obedience is disobedience. Respond while the Spirit prompts you. (Hebrews 3:15)
